name: comicarr
description: Comicarr is a specialized automated comic book downloader and management tool (akin to Sonarr/Readarr) designed to integrate with indexers and torrent/nzb clients to seamlessly manage your digital comic collection. After first boot, you'll need the setup key. To get it run in terminal: docker logs comicarr 2>&1 | grep SETUP

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Host mount for app data. Comicarr writes to /config/comicarr/ (database, config, logs, .secure/). Back this up.

paths.name: Path to comics
paths.description: Your comic book library. Comicarr organizes files here.

paths.name: Path to manga
paths.description: Your manga library. Used for MangaDex downloads.

paths.name: Path to downloads
paths.description: Staging area for downloads before post-processing. Point your download client here.

paths.name: Optional Mylar3 Migration
paths.description: For optional Mylar3 migration (read-only, mount entire directory) # IMPORTANT: Mount the directory, not just the .db file (SQLite WAL needs sidecar files)
